parsed.main_gap: The stated coordinates of Liu’s marks are incorrect, though the intended binary-length construction is clear and repaired locally.

errors.description: The cumulative endpoints of intervals of lengths δ, 2δ, 4δ, … are (2^j−1)δ, not 2^jδ. The stated marks would not create the claimed lengths. Replacing this formula repairs the construction.
errors.quote: Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\)

parsed.notes: Apart from this arithmetic inconsistency, the drafting lemma, exact refinement lemma, cut count, subset-sum bound, and matching construction form a rigorous and essentially complete proof.
